definitions.explanation: Describes a surface or texture that is very smooth and fine, with no visible roughness.
Describes service, care, or work that pays attention to every small detail. A highly positive description of someone's approach.

examples.japanese: きめ{細|こま}かい⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
きめ{細|こま}かい⟦{泡|あわ}→泡：02175_awa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦{石鹸|せっけん}→石鹸：04981_sekken⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a soap that produces fine lather.

examples.english: Being able to give detailed guidance to each individual is an advantage of small classes.

notes:
USAGE:
きめ{細|こま}かい combines きめ ({木目|きめ}, grain or texture) with ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧ (fine, detailed). It is often written partly in hiragana. The word works both as a literal description of texture and as a figurative description of thoroughness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- きめ{細|こま}かい⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (fine-grained skin)
- きめ{細|こま}かい⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (attentive service)
- きめ{細|こま}かい⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (detailed response)
- きめ{細|こま}かい⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧ (thorough instruction)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧ means polite or careful and focuses on manner and politeness. きめ{細|こま}かい emphasizes paying attention to small details and leaving nothing overlooked.
